name: onepassword
title: 1Password
description: A 1Password vault, read and written through the 1Password CLI (`op`) signed in on this machine. One item per value; the vault is the unit of access.

install.linux: sh -c 'curl -sS https://downloads.1password.com/linux/keys/1password.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor --output /usr/share/keyrings/1password-archive-keyring.gpg && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/1password-archive-keyring.gpg] https://downloads.1password.com/linux/debian/$(dpkg --print-architecture) stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/1password.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y 1password-cli'
